panels.description: Why containers of this workload last died. kube-state-metrics keeps the last termination for as long as the pod object lives, so a row is history, not a container that is down right now - read it together with Available and Replicas. istio-proxy is not filtered out the way it is on the usage panels, because a sidecar that gets OOMKilled takes the pod with it.
